  KT_AUTO_HSO_CLEAR();

      KT_AUTO_HSO_ADD(Origin);

  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_Multi:
      // Please write your own code outside.
      // Because MultiList is not supported.
      break;
  case Field_KtCourseGuardCmd_View:
      // Please write your own code outside.
      // Because the component count is 0.
      break;
  default:
      break;
  }
